name: Giant Space Hamster
sourcePageKind: The official book index lists the entry. The direct monster page redirects to the box-set store without entitlement.
sourceWitness: Visually read the original English first printing in a digital facsimile of the combined box-set volumes. The page number is the printed Boo’s Astral Menagerie folio, and the page image is a separate numbered viewer sheet.
errataEvidence: No entry-specific correction is listed in the official Spelljammer errata or its 2022 .
habitatEvidence: Wildspace is the book’s setting and the entry describes the animals as potential spelljamming ship power and trained mounts.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the original square matte parchment portrait, informed by the first printing.
sourceNotes: The Giant Space Hamster stat block is a Large Beast. The Tiny Space Hamster alongside it in this volume is a Monstrosity and has separate rules. The source describes the smaller animal as magically miniaturized from the giant one, supporting shared anatomy in the portrait.
